tool_input.description: Probe CSVFormat Builder API with a throwaway file outside tests/

result: Created `tests/org/apache/commons/csv/CSVPrinterAgentTest.java` with 25 JUnit 3.8 tests covering `CSVPrinter`'s documented contract: constructor null-checks, `print`/`println` quoting and delimiter/record-separator behavior, `printRecord`/`printRecords` (varargs, `Iterable`, array, and `ResultSet` via a dynamic proxy fake), `printComment` (disabled, single-line, multi-line), header-on-construction, and `flush()`/`close()` delegation to the underlying `Appendable`. `./compile.sh` reports `compiled OK`.
